text:
Leah Kim: FYI DAST/staging run flagged an open-redirect in our SSO callback handler, but SAST also surfaced a related issue: generator is embedding a temporary signing key when run in CI.
Tom Rivers: can you paste the DAST finding + the SAST snippet?
Leah Kim: DAST: https://scan.example/reports/DAST-7654 - open redirect on `/auth/callback` when `next` param not validated. SAST shows this in `gen/auth_callback.go` with literal `TEMP_SIGNING_KEY = \"...\"`.
scanbot: run#3245 - DAST high (open-redirect), SAST medium (hardcoded secret). fingerprints: dast:sha1:9b7a, sast:sha256:ccf1. collector=staging-scan.
Ana Gomez: Is the generator run using a deploy token in the runner? We should assume token might leak into generated files if code-gen runs with fetch creds.
Jared: yes, CI does `git submodule update` and then `make gen` with the same runner. The submodule fetch uses an ephemeral deploy token pulled from Vault via KMS.
Leah Kim: we need a short-term mitigation before changing generator: 1) suppress SAST on generated directory with evidence + expiration (per policy), 2) add runtime guard in handler to strictly validate `next` param, 3) enrich audit logs so we can prove decryption happened during the build.
Tom Rivers: re: suppression - security policy requires: suppression PR, attach raw scanner output, a repro script, `fingerprint`, two approvers (sec + owning team), and an entry in the suppression index. If >72h we escalate.
Ana Gomez: Also we must not change scanner RBAC broadly. Better to restrict the generator's access to secrets. Can infra create a least-privilege role that allows fetch-only of proto artifacts without decrypt privileges?
infra-bot: suggested role `ci:artifact-fetcher` with permissions: S3:GetObject on `ci-artifacts/*`, no KMS:Decrypt. Proposal: run proto fetch as separate job that runs with that role, then run generator in a sanitized environment.
Jared: potential issue: some language generators embed signing keys for test harnesses if a `DEV_SIGNING_KEY` env var exists. We should audit the generator to stop writing any env var content as literals.
Leah Kim: evidence we need for suppression PR: full SAST JSON, exact file path, `gen` repro where generator run with vault token yields literal, and a short risk assessment stating why suppression is limited and temporary.
scanbot: suppression template: `/suppress rule=hardcoded-secret scope=gen/** fingerprint=sha256:ccf1 expires=2025-04-15 reason=\"CI-injected artifact; token in generator run\" evidence=https://artifacts.example/build/3245/raw-scan.json`
Tom Rivers: For auditability, infra must attach `ci.run_id` and `repo` to KMS decrypt calls, plus add `ci.step` for the runner step. Logs retained 180 days for now. Security needs a one-off query after suppression to validate.
Ana Gomez: we should implement a canary: run the new two-step workflow (fetch w/ fetcher role, gen in sandbox) in parallel for 48 hours and compare outputs.
Jared: I'll open three items now: (A) suppression PR draft in repo `teams/auth` referencing fingerprint, (B) infra PR to add `ci.run_id` to KMS decrypt metadata and create `ci:artifact-fetcher` role, (C) eng ticket to remove any code-paths that emit env literals in the generator.
Leah Kim: tag `@security` and `@dev-tools` on all PRs. I'll be the security reviewer on the suppression PR.
Tom Rivers: add a unit test in gen pipeline to fail if output contains patterns matching `-----BEGIN` or `AKIA|TEMP_SIGNING_KEY`. Keep test gated behind CI flag to avoid flakiness.
infra-bot: infra/PR#778: add `ci.run_id` attribute to KMS decrypt, create role proposal `ci:artifact-fetcher`.
Jared: teams/auth/PR#56 (suppression draft) created: includes raw scan JSON and `repro.sh` that runs `make gen` with a mock vault token to reproduce.
Leah Kim: timeline: suppression PR to go up now, infra PR to land within 4 hours, canary for 48h, generator fix next sprint.
Tom Rivers: once suppression merges, security will run the query: `SELECT * FROM kms_audit WHERE attrs.ci_run_id='1747777000' AND key_id='projects/redwood/keys/build'` to verify decrypt event.
Leah Kim: also addressing DAST: quick fix pushed to staging to sanitize `next` param using whitelist of internal hosts. Longer term add automated fuzz tests for auth callback.
scanbot: actions recorded: infra/PR#778, teams/auth/PR#56, gen/issue#1023.
Ana Gomez: I'll follow up on generator cleanup and help with test coverage.
Leah Kim: thanks everyone. I'll update the suppression index and add incident-note link in the PR per the suppression workflow.
Tom Rivers: closing loop tomorrow after audit query. :lock:
